messages: elinor: Quick FYI — noticed the 'Getting started' guide has a few anchor IDs that changed after the TOC refactor, which breaks the cross-page links. Example: https://kb.redwood.ai/guides/getting-started#install -> now 404 on anchor. Can someone do a tiny rewrite/redirecting anchors so old links don't break? I can open a 1-line PR but I'm heads-down today. ryan: thanks for flagging. can you paste the page path and problematic anchors? elinor: path: docs/guides/getting-started.md Problem anchors I saw: '#install', '#first-run', '#env-setup' — they got normalized to '#setup-install' etc after a move. small sed would fix locally. docs-bot: crawler found 7 internal link failures referencing those anchors in kb index. report: https://internal.kb/reports/anchor-failures/1769012345 sam: @elinor if you leave the PR diff I can pick it up in the afternoon. small pref to add 301-style html anchors and preserve old ids in the markdown frontmatter. maria: quick ask — can we instead prefer non-fragile links (full subheaders) in future? e.g. avoid linking to fragile anchor ids in task-runbooks. alex: +1 on non-fragile links. For now, small patch is fine. Suggest adding this redirect snippet to the top of the MD file: ``` ``` kevin: I can open the PR in a few hours and include tests in the link-check CI. will also add a tiny note in the docs contributing guide. elinor: amazing, thank you. @kevin please tag me on the PR so I can verify the affected shortlinks. If someone else wants to own long-term sweep, let's sync in docs triage tomorrow. :thumbsup: sam: ping me if you want me to land it — I'll do a quick CR. :eyes: kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood-infra/docs/pull/7890 — includes the three legacy anchors + unit test fix. added changelog note. docs-bot: CI linkcheck passed for the PR branch. elinor: verified links on staging. passing. thanks everyone! :party:
